format: Follows CPC 2010 ss.123–124 (in force from 15/9/2026): the charge states the offence (by name where the law gives one), the provision it is punishable under, and details of time, place and the person or thing involved.
disclaimer: Drafting guide only. Not the prescribed form. Check the wording against the evidence and the current Act before use.

templates.title: Murder — s.300(a), intention to cause death

fields.label: Deceased (name and ID)
fields.placeholder: Lim Ah Seng, NRIC No. S7654321B

fields.label: Act causing death (to wit)
fields.placeholder: stabbing him multiple times with a knife

templates.particulars: did commit murder by causing the death of one {victim}, to wit, by {act}, with the intention of causing death
notes: s.302(1) is for murder within s.300(a) (intention to cause death) and carries the mandatory death penalty. For s.300(b)–(d), use s.302(2).
Murder is a named offence, so it may be charged by that name (CPC s.123(2), illustration (c)).

templates.title: Murder — s.300(b), (c) or (d)

fields.label: Deceased (name and ID)
fields.placeholder: Lim Ah Seng, NRIC No. S7654321B

fields.label: Act causing death (to wit)
fields.placeholder: striking his head with a metal pipe

fields.label: Limb of s.300
options: with the intention of causing such bodily injury as you knew to be likely to cause death (s.300(b))
with the intention of causing bodily injury which was sufficient in the ordinary course of nature to cause death (s.300(c))
with knowledge that the act was so imminently dangerous that it must in all probability cause death or such bodily injury as is likely to cause death (s.300(d))

templates.particulars: did commit murder by causing the death of one {victim}, to wit, by {act}, {limb}
notes: Punishment: death or imprisonment for life, and if not punished with death, also liable to caning.

templates.title: Voluntarily causing hurt

fields.label: Victim (name and ID)
fields.placeholder: Tan Ah Kow, NRIC No. S1234567A

fields.label: Act done (to wit)
fields.placeholder: punching him on the face

templates.particulars: did voluntarily cause hurt to one {victim}, to wit, by {act}
notes: Max: 3 years, or fine up to $5,000, or both. Not for cases under s.323A (grievous hurt caused) or s.334 (grave and sudden provocation).

templates.title: Voluntarily causing hurt by dangerous weapons or means

fields.label: Victim (name and ID)
fields.placeholder: Tan Ah Kow, NRIC No. S1234567A

fields.label: Weapon or means
fields.placeholder: a knife, an instrument for cutting

fields.label: Act done (to wit)
fields.placeholder: punching him on the face

templates.particulars: did voluntarily cause hurt to one {victim} by means of {means}, to wit, by {act}
notes: s.324 covers instruments for shooting, stabbing or cutting, instruments likely to cause death if used as a weapon, fire or heated substances, poison, corrosive or explosive substances, harmful substances, and animals. Max: 7 years, or fine, or caning, or any combination.

templates.title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt

fields.label: Victim (name and ID)
fields.placeholder: Tan Ah Kow, NRIC No. S1234567A

fields.label: Act done (to wit)
fields.placeholder: punching him on the face

fields.label: Grievous hurt caused
fields.placeholder: a fracture of the left cheekbone

templates.particulars: did voluntarily cause grievous hurt to one {victim}, to wit, by {act}, thereby causing {injury}
notes: Max: 10 years, and liable to fine or caning. Not for cases under s.323A, s.334A or s.335.
Grievous hurt is defined in s.320. State the specific injury.

templates.title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt by dangerous weapons or means

fields.label: Victim (name and ID)
fields.placeholder: Tan Ah Kow, NRIC No. S1234567A

fields.label: Weapon or means
fields.placeholder: a knife, an instrument for cutting

fields.label: Act done (to wit)
fields.placeholder: punching him on the face

fields.label: Grievous hurt caused
fields.placeholder: a deep laceration requiring surgery

templates.particulars: did voluntarily cause grievous hurt to one {victim} by means of {means}, to wit, by {act}, thereby causing {injury}
notes: Punishable with imprisonment for life, or up to 15 years, plus fine or caning. Not for cases under s.335.

templates.title: Assault or criminal force to outrage modesty

fields.label: Victim (name and ID)
fields.placeholder: Tan Ah Kow, NRIC No. S1234567A

fields.label: Act done (to wit)
fields.placeholder: touching her buttocks with your hand

fields.label: Assault or criminal force
options: use criminal force on
assault

templates.particulars: did {force} one {victim}, to wit, by {act}, intending to outrage the modesty of the said {victim}
notes: Statutory mental element: "intending to outrage or knowing it to be likely that he will thereby outrage the modesty". Pick the limb that fits the evidence.
Victim below 14 years of age: use s.354(2) (max 5 years).

templates.title: Word or gesture intended to insult modesty

fields.label: Victim (name and ID)
fields.placeholder: Tan Ah Kow, NRIC No. S1234567A

fields.label: Word, sound, gesture or object (to wit)
fields.placeholder: uttering the words "..."

fields.label: Intending that it be
options: such word or sound will be heard
such gesture or object will be seen

templates.particulars: did, intending to insult the modesty of one {victim}, {act}, intending that {perceive} by the said {victim}
notes: Max: 1 year, or fine, or both. Replaces the former s.509.

templates.title: Theft

fields.label: Property
fields.placeholder: one black iPhone 15 mobile phone

fields.label: In the possession of
fields.placeholder: Tan Ah Kow, NRIC No. S1234567A

templates.particulars: did commit theft of {property}, valued at about S${value}, in the possession of one {victim}
notes: Theft is a named offence (CPC s.123 illustration (c)). Max: 3 years, or fine, or both.
For a motor vehicle or a component part, use s.379A.

templates.title: Theft in dwelling house, etc.

fields.label: Building / tent / vessel
fields.placeholder: the residential unit at Blk 123 #01-234

fields.label: Used as
options: a human dwelling
a place for the custody of property

fields.label: Property
fields.placeholder: one black iPhone 15 mobile phone

fields.label: In the possession of
fields.placeholder: Tan Ah Kow, NRIC No. S1234567A

templates.particulars: did commit theft in {premises}, a building used as {use}, of {property}, valued at about S${value}, in the possession of one {victim}
notes: Applies to theft in any building, tent or vessel used as a human dwelling or for the custody of property. Max: 7 years, and liable to fine.

templates.title: Extortion

fields.label: Victim (name and ID)
fields.placeholder: Tan Ah Kow, NRIC No. S1234567A

fields.label: Harm threatened (fear of ...)
fields.placeholder: injury to his body

fields.label: Property delivered
fields.placeholder: S$500 in cash

fields.label: Delivered to
fields.placeholder: you

templates.particulars: did commit extortion by intentionally putting one {victim} in fear of {harm}, and thereby dishonestly inducing the said {victim} to deliver {property} to {recipient}
notes: Extortion is defined in s.383. Punishment (from 17/8/2026): imprisonment of not less than 2 and not more than 7 years, and liable to caning.

templates.title: Dishonest misappropriation of property

fields.label: Property
fields.placeholder: one black iPhone 15 mobile phone

fields.label: Belonging to
fields.placeholder: Tan Ah Kow, NRIC No. S1234567A

templates.particulars: did dishonestly misappropriate to your own use {property}, valued at about S${value}, belonging to one {victim}
notes: Statutory words: "dishonestly misappropriates or converts to his own use movable property". Max: 2 years, or fine, or both.
For s.403 a charge may state the gross sum and a date range of up to 12 months without listing each item or exact date, and is deemed one offence (CPC s.124(2)–(3)). Use the date-range option.

templates.title: Criminal breach of trust

fields.label: Property
fields.placeholder: one black iPhone 15 mobile phone

fields.label: Entrusted by
fields.placeholder: Tan Ah Kow, NRIC No. S1234567A

fields.label: How (dishonestly ...)
fields.placeholder: misappropriated the said property

templates.particulars: being entrusted with {property}, valued at about S${value}, by one {entrustedBy}, did commit criminal breach of trust in respect of the said property, to wit, by dishonestly {mode}
notes: Criminal breach of trust is defined in s.405. Max: 7 years, or fine, or both.
Gross sum and date range allowed (CPC s.124(3)(a)).

templates.title: Criminal breach of trust by employee

fields.label: Employer
fields.placeholder: ABC Pte Ltd (UEN 201912345K)

fields.label: Role
fields.placeholder: cashier

fields.label: Property
fields.placeholder: one black iPhone 15 mobile phone

fields.label: How (dishonestly ...)
fields.placeholder: misappropriated the said sum

templates.particulars: being an employee, to wit, a {role} of {employer}, and being in such capacity entrusted with {property}, valued at about S${value}, did commit criminal breach of trust in respect of the said property, to wit, by dishonestly {mode}
notes: Max: 15 years, and liable to fine.
Gross sum and date range allowed (CPC s.124(3)(a)).

templates.title: Criminal breach of trust by public servant, agent, director, etc.

fields.label: Capacity
options: in your capacity as a public servant, to wit, a [designation] of [agency]
in the way of your business as an agent
in your capacity as a director of [company]
in your capacity as an officer of [association]

fields.label: Property
fields.placeholder: one black iPhone 15 mobile phone

fields.label: How (dishonestly ...)
fields.placeholder: misappropriated the said sum

templates.particulars: being entrusted with {property}, valued at about S${value}, {capacity}, did commit criminal breach of trust in respect of the said property, to wit, by dishonestly {mode}
notes: Capacities listed in s.409(1)(a)–(e): public servant; banker, merchant, factor, broker, attorney or agent; professional capacity; director of a corporation; officer of an unincorporated association. Check the current text for the punishment.
Gross sum and date range allowed (CPC s.124(3)(a)).

templates.title: Receiving or retaining stolen property

fields.label: Receive or retain
options: receive
retain

fields.label: Property
fields.placeholder: one black iPhone 15 mobile phone

fields.label: Property obtained through
options: stolen property
property obtained in whole or in part through an offence involving fraud or dishonesty

templates.particulars: did {mode} {property}, valued at about S${value}, knowing or having reason to believe the same to be {origin}
notes: Statutory words: "receives or retains any property, knowing or having reason to believe the property to be stolen property or property obtained in whole or in part through an offence involving fraud or dishonesty". Max: 5 years, or fine, or both.
Gross sum and date range allowed (CPC s.124(3)(a)).

templates.title: Cheating

fields.label: Victim (name and ID)
fields.placeholder: Tan Ah Kow, NRIC No. S1234567A

fields.label: Deception ("into believing that ...")
fields.placeholder: you were an officer from the bank

fields.label: Induced to ("to ...")
fields.placeholder: disclose her online banking credentials to you

templates.particulars: did cheat one {victim}, by deceiving the said {victim} into believing that {deception}, and by such manner of deception you intentionally induced the said {victim} to {inducement}, which the said {victim} would not have done if not so deceived
notes: Cheating is defined in s.415. Max: 3 years, or fine, or both.
If the victim was induced to deliver property, use s.420.

templates.title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property

fields.label: Victim (name and ID)
fields.placeholder: Tan Ah Kow, NRIC No. S1234567A

fields.label: Deception ("into believing that ...")
fields.placeholder: you would deliver a Rolex watch to her upon payment

fields.label: Property delivered
fields.placeholder: S$3,500 in cash

fields.label: Delivered to
fields.placeholder: you

templates.particulars: did cheat one {victim}, by deceiving the said {victim} into believing that {deception}, and by such manner of deception you dishonestly induced the said {victim} to deliver {property} to {recipient}
notes: Cheating is a named offence (CPC s.123 illustration (c)). Max: 10 years, and liable to fine or caning or both.
If the cheating was by remote communication, check s.420(2).

templates.title: Mischief

fields.label: Act done (to wit)
fields.placeholder: smashing the windscreen of motor car SGX1234A with a hammer

fields.label: Property belonging to
fields.placeholder: Tan Ah Kow, NRIC No. S1234567A

templates.particulars: did commit mischief by {act}, the said property belonging to one {victim}, and thereby caused damage amounting to about S${value}
notes: Mischief is defined in s.425. Max: 2 years, or fine, or both.
For mischief disrupting a key service or Government function, check s.427.

templates.title: Criminal trespass

fields.label: Property entered
fields.placeholder: the residential unit at Blk 123 #01-234

fields.label: In the possession of
fields.placeholder: Tan Ah Kow, NRIC No. S1234567A

fields.label: With intent to
fields.placeholder: annoy the said occupant

templates.particulars: did commit criminal trespass by entering into {premises}, in the possession of one {victim}, with intent to {intent}
notes: Criminal trespass is defined in s.441. Max: 3 months, or fine up to $1,500, or both.

templates.title: House-breaking

fields.label: Building entered
fields.placeholder: the residential unit at Blk 123 #01-234

fields.label: Building used as
options: a human dwelling
a place for the custody of property

fields.label: In the possession of
fields.placeholder: Tan Ah Kow, NRIC No. S1234567A

fields.label: With intent to
fields.placeholder: commit theft therein

templates.particulars: did commit house-breaking by entering into {premises}, a building used as {use}, in the possession of one {victim}, with intent to {intent}
notes: House-breaking is defined in s.442 (criminal trespass into a building, tent, container or vessel used as a human dwelling, or a building used for worship or the custody of property). Max: 3 years, or fine, or both.
For house-breaking to commit an offence punishable with death or imprisonment, see ss.449–451.

templates.title: Criminal intimidation

fields.label: Victim (name and ID)
fields.placeholder: Tan Ah Kow, NRIC No. S1234567A

fields.label: Threat (to wit)
fields.placeholder: saying to him "I will kill you"

fields.label: Injury threatened to
options: the person
the reputation
the property

fields.label: Intent
options: to cause alarm to the said {victim}
to cause the said {victim} to do an act which the said {victim} was not legally bound to do
to cause the said {victim} to omit to do an act which the said {victim} was legally entitled to do

templates.particulars: did commit criminal intimidation by threatening one {victim} with injury to {injury} of the said {victim}, to wit, by {threat}, with intent {intent}
notes: Criminal intimidation is a named offence (CPC s.123 illustration (c)). Max: 2 years, or fine, or both. If the threat is to cause death or grievous hurt, destruction of property by fire, or an offence punishable with death or 7 years or more: max 10 years.
Check the s.503 definition for threats to a person in whom the victim is interested.
